final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_signed_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount FROM account_averages) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_signed_amount, aa.avg_signed_amount - oa.avg_signed_amount AS difference FROM account_averages AS aa JOIN overall_average AS oa ON oa.avg_signed_amount IS NOT NULL WHERE aa.avg_signed_amount > oa.avg_signed_amount ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
